verdict.rationale: Auto-defending focus time is a fair axis for a calendar product, so the story applies. The evidence only shows recurring events, free/busy queries and push notifications. These are developer building blocks a third party could use to build such a feature; nothing shows Google Calendar itself defends focus time or habits or moves them when conflicts arise.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, the product auto-defends recurring focus time and habits, flexibly moving them when conflicts appear instead of dropping them
